sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:107

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:107:1
items.html: The two of them join and become her breasts, and therefore these two Eheyehs, in their two fillings, in Yudin and in Alfin, are numerically equal to Shaddai (shin-dalet): For after the Partzuf of Tevuna diminished, by force of the coupling upon phase one, to the discernment of VAK [six ends] — since the lights of NHY rose to HGT, and the lights of HGT rose to HBD — it is found that in the relation of the lights there are only HGT NHY, which are VAK alone; and in the relation of the vessels there are only HBD HGT, lacking NHY, as above at length. Therefore the HGT of AVI are now reckoned, where the coupling of the level of Ruach is made, which is the Mochin of nursing, in which there are only the vessels of HBD HGT — namely the Eheyeh of Yudin, which is HBD, and the Eheyeh of Alfin, which is HGT. From these two Eheyehs the breasts were made, which are the vessels of these Mochin. And this is what is meant by, “The two Eheyehs, in their two fillings, are numerically equal to Shaddai, to hint that from them the breasts were made” — namely, as explained, that from the discernment of the vessels, nothing remained in them except HBD HGT alone, and from them the breasts were made, which are the vessels of the Mochin of nursing.
